title: Sóng và thủy tinh
about: Round x9, for sleep with improvised melodies (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked ("tôi muốn những bài âm thanh u tối nhưng dễ nghe để ngủ hơn, có thể thêm những giai điệu ngẫu hứng"): the far sea's slow swells, a pad, and soft glass improvising a few notes at a time above them, in D Dorian, warmer than minor. Softer harmony than before (added ninths, major sevenths, no Phrygian rub), nothing sudden. An original piece; its melody made up by the improviser in dark/ambient.py.
